---
title: "Task 2: Subsetting & Missing Data in Your Mini-Universe"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Task 2: Subsetting & Missing Data in the Universe

# Load base data
sequence_vector <- seq(10, 100, by = 5)
logical_vector <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), 10, replace = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(
  City = c("Astra", "Vega", "Lunaris", "Eos", "Terralight", "Zenith"),
  Population_k = c(150, 210, 90, 300, 250, 180),
  Coastal = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE),
  Stage = c("high", "medium", "low", "high", "medium", "low")
)

# === 2.1. Querying Vectors ===
sequence_vector[3]
sequence_vector[2:5]
sequence_vector[sequence_vector > 20]

logical_vector[logical_vector]
which(logical_vector)

# === 2.2. Querying List ===
planet_list <- list(
  description = "NovaPrime is a habitable planet in the Andromeda Sector.",
  matrix = matrix(sample(-50:50, 9), 3, 3),
  vector = sequence_vector
)

planet_list$description
planet_list[[2]]
planet_list$vector[2]

# === 2.3. Data Frame Operations ===
head(df, 3)
df[4, 1]
df$Coastal

# Logical subsetting
df_subset <- df[df$Population_k > 150, ]
df_subset

# Subsetting with %in%
df_subset_2 <- df[df$Stage %in% c("high", "medium"), ]
df_subset_2

# === 2.4. Handling Missing Data ===
df_corrupted <- df
df_corrupted[2, 3] <- NA
df_corrupted[5, 2] <- NA
df_corrupted[6, 4] <- NA

sum(is.na(df_corrupted))
colSums(is.na(df_corrupted))

mean(df_corrupted$Population_k, na.rm = TRUE)
df_clean <- na.omit(df_corrupted)
df_clean

# === 2.5. Bonus Challenge ===
highest_pop_index <- which.max(df$Population_k)
df[highest_pop_index, ]
```
